vermin.name: Rats

post_combat_effects.description: At the end of the encounter, every PC wounded by a rat must roll a 1-in-6 chance of losing 1 Life to infection.

vermin.notes: HCL+0 (Maximum L4). No Treasure. Goblins, trolls, orcs, lizardmen and ogres eat rats. Count each rat as 1 Food ration for them.

vermin.name: Vampire Bats

combat_modifiers.description: Spellcasting rolls are at -1 due to their distracting shrieking.

vermin.notes: HCL+0 (Maximum L3). No Treasure. Despite the vampire moniker, these creatures are animals, not undead.

vermin.name: Goblin Swarmlings

combat_modifiers.description: Dwarves attack goblin swarmlings at +1 to Attack rolls.

reactions.result: The goblin swarmlings flee if outnumbered.
The goblin swarmlings demand a bribe.

vermin.notes: HCL+1 Vermin (Maximum L4). When rolling for treasure -1. When rolling for Morale -1.

on_hit_effects.description: All living PCs hit by a centipede must Save vs. L2 poison or lose 1 additional Life.

reactions.result: The giant centipedes flee if outnumbered.
The vampire frogs demand a Blood Offering.
The vampire frogs fight to the death!

vermin.name: Skeletal Rats

vulnerabilities.description: Crushing weapons attack Skeletal Rats at +1.
A vial of Holy water automatically kills 2 skeletal rats.

vermin.notes: HCL+2 (Max Level 5). No Treasure. Immune to sleep, disease and poison. Unaffected by ranged weapons.
